The most chaotic yet sweetest best friend in the world 💕

letters.name: Subho
letters.title: Happy Birthday, My Favorite Kaleshi!
letters.msg: Wish you the absolute happiest birthday, Sakshi! You make life a million times funnier, warmer, and more exciting just by existing. Never stop being your dramatic, hilarious, golden self!

letters.name: Subho
letters.title: The Unstoppable Duo
letters.msg: One message or phone call from you can change my whole day, my whole mood, and my whole mindset. Nobody gets my chaotic thoughts like you do.

letters.name: Subho
letters.title: To Our Endless Fights & Pure Friendship
letters.msg: Even when we argue over the silly things, you are always the first person I want to celebrate with. Here is to 27 Oct 2027 and every single year after that!
